title: The legend of Uma and her curse
introduction: Shiva on his marriage with Uma is in the conjugal bliss for a long period due to his yogic powers. Fearing the result of that prolonged activity all gods pray for the cessation of it because none in any world can carry that offspring. Shiva accepting that request asks them where to discharge the sperm that has already stirred up. Gods indicate the earth as the taker. Shiva accordingly inundates the earth with his fluid. Then the Fire-god is dispatched to consolidate that into a reed forest called sharavaNa . Goddess Uma ireful at the prevention of begetting a son, now curses gods and earth to be childless.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षट्त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 36th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
उक्तवाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन्नुभौ राघवलक्ष्मणौ |
प्रतिनन्द्य कथां वीरौ ऊचतुर्मुनिपुंगवम्
verses.iast:
ukta vākye munau tasmin ubhau rāghava lakṣmaṇau |
pratinandya kathām vīrau ūcatuḥ muni puṅgavam
verses.translation: When that sage Vishvamitra has finished narration of the legend of the daughters of Himavanta, both the brave ones, namely Raghava and Lakshmana in their turn have extolled that legend and spoke to that eminent-sage.

glosses.meaning: who has spoken word - who said so - finished narration
at the story, in turn, praised it

verses.devanagari:
धर्मयुक्तमिदं ब्रह्मन् कथितं परमं त्वया |
दुहितुः शैलराजस्य ज्येष्ठाय वक्तुमर्हसि |
विस्तरं विस्तरज्ञोऽसि दिव्यमानुषसंभवम्
verses.iast:
dharma yuktam idam brahman kathitam paramam tvayā |
duhituḥ śaila rājasya jyeṣṭhāya vaktum ar.hhasi |
vistaram vistarajño asi divya mānuṣa sambhavam
verses.translation: "This admirable discourse given by you about Ganga is exhaustive in righteousness, oh, Brahman, and it will be apt of you to tell emphatically about the divine and earthly legend of the elder daughter of Himavanta, namely Ganga, for you are aware to expatiate upon it.

glosses.meaning: emphatically, to tell, apt of you
expatiation, knower - aware olf, you are.

verses.devanagari:
त्रीन्पथो हेतुना केन पावयेल्लोकपावनी |
कथं गङ्गा त्रिपथगा विश्रुता सरिदुत्तमा
त्रिषु लोकेषु धर्मज्ञ कर्मभिः कैः समन्विता |
verses.iast:
trīn patho hetunā kena pāvayet loka pāvanī |
katham gañgā tripathagā viśrutā sarit uttamā
triṣu lokeṣu dharmajña karmabhiḥ kaiḥ samanvitā |
verses.translation: "By which reason that world purifier Ganga influxes into three paths? Oh, virtue-knower, and connected with which deeds of merit this triple-courser Ganga is renowned as the best one among all the rivers in three worlds?" Thus Rama and Lakshmana have asked the sage Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: three, paths, she is flooding - flowing
by which, deeds, she is connected with - deeds of merit

verses.devanagari:
तथा ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे विश्वामित्रस्तपोधनः
निखिलेन कथां सर्वामृषिमध्ये न्यवेदयत् |
verses.iast:
tathā bruvati kākutsthe viśvāmitraḥ tapodhanaḥ
nikhilena kathām sarvām ṛṣi madhye nyavedayat |
verses.translation: When Kakutstha-s have enquired that way, the ascetically-wealthy sage Vishvamitra has narrated all the legend of Ganga in its entirety, staying among the sages.

glosses.meaning: by Kakutstha-s [Rama, Lakshmana,] that way, said

verses.devanagari:
पुरा रामकृतोद्वाहः शितिकण्ठो महातपाः
दृष्ट्वा च भगवान् देवीं मैथुनायोपचक्रमे |
verses.iast:
purā rāma kṛta udvāhaḥ śiti kaṇṭho mahā tapāḥ
dṛṣṭvā ca bhagavān devīm maithunāya upacakrame |
verses.translation: "On his getting married to Uma, oh, Rama, the sublime-ascetic and bluish throated god Shiva, as his throat became blue when he consumed poison during the churning of Milky Ocean, at one time with a predilection towards her he has started lovemaking with her.

glosses.meaning: sublime, ascetic, blue, throated god - Shiva

verses.devanagari:
तस्य संक्रीडमानस्य महादेवस्य धीमतः |
शितिकण्ठस्य देवस्य दिव्यं वर्षशतं गतम्
न चापि तनयो राम तस्यामासीत्परंतप |
verses.iast:
tasya saṅkrīḍamānasya mahādevasya dhīmataḥ |
śitikaṇṭhasya devasya divyam varṣa śatam gatam
na ca api tanayo rāma tasyām āsīt parantapa |
verses.translation: "While that sublime, sagacious and blue-throated God Shiva is in lovemaking, oh, enemy-scorcher Rama, a hundred divine years have elapsed, even then he had no son in her, namely Goddess Uma. [1-36-6b, c, 7]
notes: The hundred divine years are said to be 36,000 mortal years and this goes with the calculation of yuga Indian 'era' calculation where two thousand of four yuga-s, kṛta, treta, dvāpara, kali yuga-s are one brahma dina Brahma's day etc.

glosses.meaning: of god, blue-throated Shiva, while nuptial merrymaking - lovemaking
son, has not, become - not born.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे देवाः समुद्युक्ताः पितामहपुरोगमाः
यदिहोत्पद्यते भूतं कः तत्प्रतिसहिष्यति |
verses.iast:
sarve devāḥ samudyuktāḥ pitāmaha purogamāḥ
yat iha utpadyate bhūtam kaḥ tat pratisahiṣyati |
verses.translation: "All the gods headed by Brahma have then started to ponder, 'is there anybody who can inevitably sustain that being which emerges from this goddess Uma after this prolonged yogic act of copulation with Shiva?' This being the worry of all gods they have prepared for action.

glosses.meaning: Forefather [Brahma], going before- leading the delegation

verses.devanagari:
अभिगम्य सुराः सर्वे प्रणिपत्येदमब्रुवन्
देव देव महादेव लोकस्यास्य हिते रत |
सुराणां प्रणिपातेन प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
abhigaṃya surāḥ sarve praṇipatya idam abruvan
deva deva mahādeva lokasya asya hite rata |
surāṇām praṇipātena prasādam kartum arhasi
verses.translation: "All of the gods on approaching and paying their deference to Shiva spoke this to him, 'oh, God of Gods, oh, one who is interested in the welfare of these worlds, oh, Great-God, considering the supplication of all gods it will be apt of you to bestow grace.'
notes: This prolonged act of copulation is an act of yoga called mahā maithuna. The Shaktaite Tantriks who practise panca ma kāra : madya, māmsa, matsya, mudra, maithuna 'liquor' 'mutton' 'fish' 'postures' [loosely: callisthenics] and 'copulation' make use of these things. In these practises, the yogis use mudra-s 'posture' 'callisthenics' at the time of copulation even, so that there will be no ejaculation for a longer period. This is their 'Five-element theory...'

glosses.meaning: gods, all of them, towards, on going - on approaching Shiva
paying deference to [Siva,] this, they spoke
oh, God of Gods, asya lokasya hite rata = of this, world's, welfare, oh, one who is interested in
of gods, such as we are
grace, to bestow, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
न लोका धारयिष्यन्ति तव तेजः सुरोत्तम |
ब्राह्मेण तपसा युक्तो देव्या सह तपश्चर
त्रैलोक्यहितकामार्थं तेजस्तेजसि धारय |
रक्ष सर्वानिमान् लोकान्नालोकं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
na lokā dhārayiṣyanti tava tejaḥ surottama |
brāhmeṇa tapasā yukto devyā saha tapaḥ cara
trailokya hita kāma artham tejaḥ tejasi dhāraya |
rakṣa sarvān imān lokān na alokam kartum arhasi
verses.translation: " 'Worlds cannot capably bear your offspring born out of your effulgence, oh, Supreme-God, hence you may practice yogic asceticism along with your consort Goddess Uma in unison with Vedic postulates of Yoga, rather than progeniture, and desiring the welfare of the three worlds you may please retain your refulgent seed within your own radiance, thus protect this universe, since it will not be apt of you to render it devoid of worlds with the efflux of the unmanageable potence of yours .' So said gods to Shiva.
notes: The word tejas also means semen, or offspring, besides resplendence tejaḥ parākrame prāṇe varcas arciṣi retasi - ratnamāla thus the prospective offspring through ejaculation is the problem here, because Kumara, or, Skanda takes birth with all the irrepressible effulgence of Shiva, plus his own.

glosses.meaning: oh, of gods, supreme one - oh, supreme god
your, offspring born out of your effulgence
worlds, cannot be, capable to bear
as per Vedic ancillary [Yoga,] postulates of asceticism, unified with
your refulgent seed, in your own radiance, you sustain. rakSa sarvaan imaan lokaan = protect, all, these, worlds [in universe]
not, devoid of [annihilate], worlds [in universe,] to render, apt of you

verses.devanagari:
देवतानां वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः |
बाढमित्यब्रवीत् सर्वान् पुनश्चेदमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
devatānām vacaḥ śrutvā sarva loka maheśvaraḥ |
bāḍham iti abravīt sarvān punaḥ ca idam uvāca ha
verses.translation: "On listening the words of gods that Rarefied-God of Universe, namely Shiva said, 'so be it,' and further spoke this to all of the gods, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
धारयिष्याम्यहं तेजस्तेजस्येव सहोमया |
त्रिदशाः पृथिवी चैव निर्वाणमधिगच्छतु
verses.iast:
dhārayiṣyāmi aham tejaḥ tejasi eva saha umayā |
tridaśāḥ pṛthivī caiva nirvāṇam adhigacchatu
verses.translation: " 'I wish to bear my sperm in my virility and Uma in hers, let the immortals and mortals as well, derive a perfect bliss.

verses.devanagari:
यदिदं क्षुभितं स्थानान्मम तेजो ह्यनुत्तमम् |
धारयिष्यति कस्तन्मे ब्रुवन्तु सुरसत्तमाः
verses.iast:
yad idam kṣubhitam sthānāt mama tejo hi anuttamam |
dhārayiṣyati kaḥ tat me bruvantu sura sattamāḥ
verses.translation: " 'But that part which has already stirred up from its place is irrestrainable, as such, oh gods of eminence, you tell me who can contain that part of the unexcelled potence.' So said Shiva to gods.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तास्ततो देवाः प्रत्यूचुर्वृषभध्वजम् |
यत्तेजः क्षुभितं ह्यद्य तद्धरा धारयिष्यति
verses.iast:
evam uktāḥ tato devāḥ pratyūcur vṛṣabha dhvajam |
yat tejaḥ kṣubhitam hi adya tad dharā dhārayiṣyati
verses.translation: "Thus spoken by Shiva, then the gods in reply spoke to him whose banner is Divine-Bull, namely Shiva, 'that part of the potence which has already stirred up, the earth indeed endures that now.

glosses.meaning: thus, who are spoken to [by Shiva]

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तः सुरपतिः प्रमुमोच महाबलः |
तेजसा पृथिवी येन व्याप्ता सगिरिकानना
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ sura patiḥ pramumoca mahābalaḥ |
tejasā pṛthivī yena vyāptā sa giri kānanā
verses.translation: "Thus said by the gods that Yogi of par excellence and the God of Gods, Shiva, discharged his refulgent semen with which the earth together with its mountains and forests is overspread.

glosses.meaning: greatly virile one [Yogi, of par excellence]

verses.devanagari:
ततो देवाः पुनरिदमूचुश्चापि हुताशनम् |
आविश त्वं महातेजो रौद्रं वायुसमन्वितः
verses.iast:
tato devāḥ punar idam ūcuḥ ca api hutāśanam |
āviśa tvam mahātejo raudram vāyu samanvitaḥ
verses.translation: "Thereby the gods in their turn said even to Fire-god, 'you enter the great-potence of Rudra along with Wind-god, lest that potence may annihilate the earth and earthlings, because you can consume anything that comes in touch with you.

verses.devanagari:
तदग्निना पुनर्व्याप्तं संजातं श्वेतपर्वतम् |
दिव्यं शरवणं चैव पावकादित्यसंनिभम्
यत्र जातो महातेजाः कार्तिकेयोऽग्निसंभवः |
verses.iast:
tad agninā punar vyāptam sañjātam śveta parvatam |
divyam śaravaṇam caiva pāvaka āditya saṃnibham
yatra jāto mahātejāḥ kārtikeyo agni sambhavaḥ |
verses.translation: "And when Fire-god invaded that great-potence of Shiva it has emerged as White-mountain, also thus it has become as a divine forest of reeds equalling the Sun and Fire in its resplendence, wherefrom the highly brilliant Kumara has emerged.
notes: Because Kumara, or Skanda took birth through Fire-god from the great-potence of Shiva, he is called the one born out of fire. Because Krittika stars have suckled him he is also called as Kaaritkeya. The birth and legend of Kaartikeya is detailed in the next chapter relating to Ganga.

glosses.meaning: one who is born out of the refulgence of Shiva through Fire-god
one who is suckled by Krittika-s

verses.devanagari:
अथोमां च शिवं चैव देवाः सर्षिगणास्तदा
पूजयामासुरत्यर्थं सुप्रीतमनसस्ततः |
verses.iast:
atha umām ca śivam caiva devāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ tadā
pūjayāmāsuḥ atyartham suprīta manasaḥ tataḥ |
verses.translation: "Later on, the gods together with the assemblages of sages are well pleased at heart as it has happened according to their prayer, thereby they fulsomely adored Shiva and even Uma.

glosses.meaning: thereby, as it has happened so

verses.devanagari:
अथ शैलसुता राम त्रिदशानिदमब्रवीत्
समन्युरशपत् सर्वान् क्रोधसंरक्तलोचना |
verses.iast:
atha śaila sutā rāma tridaśān idam abravīt
samanyuḥ aśapat sarvān krodha saṃrakta locanā |
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, but the daughter of Himalayan Mountain, namely Uma, while irefully saying this to the divinities she cursed them all with her eyes reddened in anger.

verses.devanagari:
यस्मान्निवारिता चाहं संगता पुत्रकाम्यया
अपत्यं स्वेषु दारेषु नोत्पादयितुमर्हथ |
verses.iast:
yasmāt nivāritā ca aham saṅgatā putra kāṃyayā
apatyam sveṣu dāreṣu na utpadayitum arhatha |
verses.translation: " 'Wherefore, I who am desirous of a son had been prevented from the intimacy with my husband, therefore you shall be infecund to beget progeny through your own wives.

glosses.meaning: I am, from intimacy, back, moved - prevented
not, to bring forth, eligible - worthy enough, infecund - you are prevented to bear children.

verses.devanagari:
अद्य प्रभृति युष्माकमप्रजाः सन्तु पत्नयः
एवमुक्त्वा सुरान्सर्वान् शशाप पृथिवीमपि |
verses.iast:
adya prabhṛti yuṣmākam aprajāḥ santu patnayaḥ
evam uktvā surān sarvān śaśāpa pṛthivīm api |
verses.translation: " 'And from now onwards you wives shall remain infertile...' and on saying this way to all of the gods she also gave a curse to the earth.
notes: Thus the celestials do not directly breed. They take the agency of humans or other mortals to bring forth their offspring as in the case of the monkey race, and Menaka, and as in the case of Vishvamitra giving birth to Shakuntala, who in her turn gave birth to Bharata, so on.

verses.devanagari:
अवने नैकरूपा त्वं बहुभार्या भविष्यसि
न च पुत्रकृतां प्रीतिं मत्क्रोधकलुषीकृता |
प्राप्स्यसि त्वं सुदुर्मेधे मम पुत्रमनिच्छती
verses.iast:
avane na eka rūpā tvam bahu bhāryā bhaviṣyasi
na ca putra kṛtām prītim mat krodha kaluṣīkṛtā |
prāpsyasi tvam sudur.hmedhe mama putram anicchatī
verses.translation: " 'Oh, Earth, your appearance shall be bizarre and you will be a wife to many. And oh, verily base-minded earth, rendered sully by my anger you shall have no gratification caused by the children as you are bigoted against my son.
notes: The sin of earth to bear the curse of Uma Devi is to accept the semen of Shiva on her surface. The appearance of earth will not be in one kind or quality for it has lands and oceans, deserts and forests, volcanoes and mountains, ice and humidity, etc. Further, the earth is the official wife to numerous kings. The earth is also cursed to not to have the delight of her children. The earth has Naraka, the demon, and Seetha as her children. But these two are not begotten through any seminal contact by earth, and further, for earth it is as good as not having these two as her children, for such is the plight of these two so-called children of earth on earth. After many tumults in her life, even Seetha asks her mother on earth, i.e., mother earth herself, to take her back into her womb.

glosses.meaning: not, with one, appearance - sui generis, bizarre
to me, son, not, desirous - you are bigoted
by my, anger, sully, rendered - sullied by my anger

verses.devanagari:
तान् सर्वान् पीडितान् दृष्ट्वा सुरान् सुरपतिस्तदा |
गमनायोपचक्राम दिशं वरुणपालिताम्
verses.iast:
tān sarvān pīḍitān dṛṣṭvā surān surapatiḥ tadā |
gamanāya upacakrāma diśam varuṇa pālitām
verses.translation: "That God of Gods Shiva becoming ill at ease to look at all of the distressed gods, equally feeling small to convince his consort Uma, he has started to journey towards the western quarter which is ruled by Rain-god.

glosses.meaning: them, all, gods, on seeing - ill at ease to see their plight

verses.devanagari:
स गत्वा तप आतिष्ठत् पार्श्वे तस्योत्तरे गिरेः |
हिमवत्प्रभवे शृंगे सह देव्या महेश्वरः
verses.iast:
sa gatvā tapa ātiṣṭhat pārśve tasya uttare gireḥ |
himavat prabhave śṛṅge saha devyā maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "On going to the northern side of Himalayan Mountains, that God of Gods, Shiva settled down in ascesis along with his consort Uma on the peak of a mountain emerged from Himalayas.
notes: Here some say the mountain on which Shiva settled for ascesis as himavat prabhava giving it a full name, like Mt. Kailash or Kanchanjunga etc. If any such mountain peak is named and available in mythologies or in Himalayas, this needs a revision.

glosses.meaning: in Himalayas, emerged [a mountain,] on its peak

verses.devanagari:
एष ते विस्तरो राम शैलपुत्र्या निवेदितः |
गङ्गायाः प्रभवं चैव शृणु मे सहलक्ष्मणः
verses.iast:
eṣa te vistaro rāma śaila putryā niveditaḥ |
gangāyāḥ prabhavam caiva śṛṇu me saha lakṣmaṇa
verses.translation: "This is the legend of mountain's daughter, namely Goddess Uma vividly narrated to you, oh, Rama, and now listen from me along with Lakshmana about the emergence of Ganga.

glosses.meaning: pertaining to mountain's, daughter eSa = this [Uma's legend]
